raw_response:
1. The figure does not show any benchmark/average line, so there’s no visual evidence that it intersects Layer 12 or indicates a deviation there. Layer 12’s total appears to be about 3 experts (stacked G0+G1+G2).

2. Layer 16 does not have 12 experts in the figure; it appears to have about 5 total experts. Layer 1 appears higher at about 9 total experts, so Layer 1 has roughly 4 more experts than Layer 16.

3. The figure provides no statistical testing (e.g., p-values, confidence intervals) or performance metrics, so the statistical significance of G1 vs G2 differences and any impact on overall model performance cannot be determined from this plot.
